query:
SELECT 
  'Products' as market,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN parentId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as main_categories
FROM product_categories
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Services' as market,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN parentId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as main_categories
FROM service_categories
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Jobs' as market,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN parentId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as main_categories
FROM job_categories;
